title: cannot find libcudnn.so.9
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

in almalinux `pip3 install torch torchvision`

```
venv/lib64/python3.11/site-packages/torch/__init__.py", line 427, in <module>
    from torch._C import *  # noqa: F403
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
ImportError: libcudnn.so.9: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

```
ok, the problem is torch install to `venv/lib64` but nvidia install to `venv/lib`, ...
